note: One record per material observation. kind: observed (what the page shows), claim (a statement the clinic makes about itself, outcomes or experience; reported as the clinic's claim, never endorsed), absence (looked for on the pages reviewed and not found; says nothing about other pages). evidence: text (excerpt must appear in the saved page text) or html (excerpt must appear in the saved page source, used for links and form attributes). Source records, fetch times and hashes come from raw/fetch_log.jsonl.
